ai_summary: Aeroflex Industries Limited plans a substantial ₹202 crore capital expenditure by March 2028 to significantly expand manufacturing capabilities for SS hoses, assemblies, and liquid cooling solutions, strategically targeting high-growth sectors like AI data center infrastructure. This expansion is projected to generate an incremental revenue of ₹500-550 crore at peak capacity utilization. The funding mix of equity, bridge loan, and internal accruals, along with the revenue projections' reliance on future demand and peak utilization, are key considerations for investors.
